recipe.title: Dump-and-Go Crockpot White Chicken Chili
recipe.summary: Creamy white chicken chili with tender chicken breast, white beans, green chiles, corn, bone broth, and Greek yogurt for approximately 51 grams of protein and 350 calories.
recipe.story: This chili is designed for a busy morning. The chicken, cans, broth, and seasonings go straight into the crockpot, while the creamy ingredients are stirred in only after the chicken is cooked and shredded.
ingredients: 36 ounces raw boneless skinless chicken breast
1 (15-ounce) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup nonfat plain Greek yogurt, at room temperature
instructions: In the morning, place the chicken in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the drained beans, frozen corn, diced green chiles, bone broth, cumin, granulated garlic, onion powder, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and shreds easily.
At night, remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the slow cooker. Switch the slow cooker to WARM.
Whisk the softened cream cheese into the hot chili until smooth.
Place the Greek yogurt in a bowl and gradually whisk in about 1/2 cup of hot broth. Stir the tempered yogurt into the chili without allowing it to boil.
Divide the chili evenly among 6 bowls.
tips: Do not add the Greek yogurt or cream cheese in the morning because long cooking can make dairy separate.
Cannellini or great northern beans both work. Drain and rinse them before adding.
For a thicker chili, mash a small portion of the beans against the side of the slow cooker before adding the dairy.
Taste before adding extra salt because bone broth and canned chiles vary in sodium.
Nutrition is approximate and varies by brand.
